incidents.name: NewFreeDAO reward contract repeatable claim
incidents.notes: The NFD reward contract paid its bonus (selector 0x6811e3b9) to any caller in proportion to that caller's NFD balance and gated it only per address, so a loop that deployed a fresh claimer contract, moved the same NFD into it and claimed again multiplied the payout without limit.

sources.ref: onchain review: reward contract 0x8b068e22e9a4a9bca3c321e0ec428abf32691d1e created 2022-09-07T04:01:07Z by 0x5b711b7d9567291bbc1bb505536d79124b85cce8, unrelated to attack sender 0x22c9736d4fc73a8fa0eb436d2ce919f5849d6fd2; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. The PoC header's 4,481 BNB / ~$125M figure is a nominal NFD amount; DeFiHackLabs and SlowMist put the realised loss at ~$1M across three transactions, which is what lossUsd records.
